h2: Best NDT inspection software: why most ranked lists get it wrong
html:
Search for the best NDT inspection software and the first page is mostly ranked lists. Several read as generated rather than tested, and they mix three kinds of product that do different jobs: maintenance systems (CMMS) such as eMaint, Fiix and Maximo, general quality management systems, and a few genuine NDT tools. A CMMS is very good at work orders for an owner's maintenance team, but it does not know what a Level II is, what a written practice requires, or what a UT calibration record must contain. Ranking it against NDT reporting software compares a forklift with a crane.

Start with who you are

If you are an NDT or inspection service company, you need NDT inspection software that tracks technician certificates, equipment calibration, crews, method reports and invoices, which is the comparison set on this page. If you own the assets, such as a refinery, pipeline or plant, you need an inspection data management system (IDMS) that holds thickness monitoring locations, corrosion rates and inspection plans for your equipment; owner-side products lead that category, and the page on inspection management software explains the split. Contractor data then feeds the owner's IDMS; the two systems are not substitutes.

Questions that separate NDT software from a generic tool

  • Does it hold personnel certification records by scheme, method and level, with vision examinations?
  • Does each method have its own report type, or is there one form with free-text fields?
  • Can a reviewer approve and sign a report as a named, qualified user?
  • Does it work offline in the field?
  • Can the report record which instrument, probe and calibration block were used, and does the equipment record show their calibration status?
  • Can the job, timesheet and invoice be linked without re-typing?

A tool that answers yes to most of these belongs on an NDT shortlist. One that answers no to the first three is a different category, whatever the list says.

Instrument software is a separate decision

Flaw-detector and phased-array analysis packages from the instrument makers are essential for acquiring and interpreting data, and they also appear in results for NDT software. They sit upstream of workflow software: the analysed result goes into the report, and the report goes into the job.

Where to go next

For the product view of Atlantis, see NDT inspection software and the NDT management software overview; for a head-to-head with one rival, see DRIVE NDT alternatives. To test the questions above on your own reports, book a demonstration.
